issue: Publish validation does not enforce required recommendation content
actual: In /admin > Add Product, submitting with only Name + Short Description filled (no full review, no image URL, no affiliate/retailer link, no specification, price left at 0) succeeded: toast 'Product created successfully' and 'QA Minimal Product' was added to the product list. Only Name, Category and Short Description are marked/enforced as required.
evidence: Admin list after submit contains 10 products including 'QA Minimal Product'.
Clicking product name 'QA Aeropress Go' on /products navigated to /product/qa-aeropress-go showing that product. Card image and name are both wrapped in the same /product/<slug> link.

Clicking 'Buy Now' on /product/qa-aeropress-go opened a new tab at https://example.com/qa-aeropress-go. All Buy Now anchors use absolute external hrefs with target=_blank rel=noopener noreferrer, each matching its own product (dyson-v15, philips-hue, breville, sony-xm5 etc.).

issue: Tag filter list does not include newly assigned tags
actual: After creating 'QA Aeropress Go' with tags 'qatagalpha, portable' (tags visible on its detail page), the /products Filters panel still lists only the 35 seeded tags (ambiance…wireless). 'qatagalpha' is absent, so it cannot be selected as a tag filter, even though the product itself is in the 10-product list.
evidence: Filters > Tags options: no 'qatagalpha' entry between 'professional' and 'recovery'.

On /products: 'SONY' -> 1 product found (Sony WH-1000XM5, name match); 'CORDLESS' -> 1 product found (Dyson V15 Detect, brief-description match); 'headphones' -> 1 product (Sony, tag-only match); 'QATAGALPHA' -> 1 product (QA Aeropress Go, tag match). Counts matched the rendered card counts each time.

Created 'QA Aeropress Go' with comma-separated tags 'qatagalpha, portable'. Detail page renders both tags as chips; /products keyword search for 'qatagalpha' and 'QATAGALPHA' each return exactly that product.

/products category dropdown: Home Goods -> '4 products found' (QA Aeropress Go, Breville, Philips Hue, Dyson); Fitness -> '3 products found' (Bowflex, Theragun, Peloton); Tech Gadgets -> '3 products found' (Samsung, MacBook, Sony). All visible cards carried the matching category badge.

Admin form Category is a single-select with exactly 3 options (Tech Gadgets / Home Goods / Fitness). Created 'QA Aeropress Go' with Home Goods; it then appeared with a 'Home' badge in the Home Goods filter (4 products), on /category/home, and on its detail page.

issue: Displayed results violate the active minimum-price criterion
actual: On /products with Price Range minimum = $200 (label shows '$200'), the list still shows 'Philips Hue Starter Kit' at $199 and reports '9 products found'. With minimum = $100 all 10 products are shown, including 'QA Aeropress Go' at $39.99. The price filter behaves as if it lags one 100-step behind the displayed minimum. Search/category/rating criteria were satisfied correctly in other checks.
evidence: min=$100 -> 10 products incl. $39.99; min=$200 -> 9 products incl. $199; min=$1250 -> 3 products (all >= $1299) i.e. $749 excluded but boundary off.

issue: Price-range filter applies the wrong threshold (off by one step)
actual: Sorting works: Newest, Top Rated (4.9→4.2), Price Low→High ($39.99→$2,495) and High→Low all ordered correctly. Minimum Rating '4.5+ stars' correctly returned 8 products all rated >=4.5. However the Price Range filter is wrong: with the minimum shown as $200 the $199 Philips Hue Starter Kit is still listed (9 products found); with the minimum shown as $100 the $39.99 product is still listed (10 products found).
evidence: Price Range control also offers only a single 'Minimum' thumb (no maximum), labelled '$200 - $2495'.

On /products all criterion changes re-rendered instantly with no navigation/reload (URL stayed http://localhost:6001/products): typing in the search box, switching category (All/Tech/Home/Fitness), changing sort (Newest/Top Rated/Price asc/desc), moving the price slider and selecting a minimum rating each updated the card set, their order and the 'N products found' counter live.

/products lists every product; each card exposes image (alt=product name), category badge (Tech/Home/Fitness), price, 5-star widget with numeric rating, brief description paragraph, and a 'Buy Now' external link. Verified for all 10 cards.

issue: Category dropdown on category pages is inert
actual: On /category/tech the category dropdown offers All Categories / Tech Gadgets / Home Goods / Fitness, but selecting 'Fitness' and then 'Home Goods' left the trigger showing 'Tech Gadgets', the heading 'Tech Gadgets', the URL /category/tech and the same 3 Tech products. Neither the active category nor the displayed products changed. (The equivalent dropdown on /products works correctly.)

evidence: /product/does-not-exist-123 renders 'Product Not Found' with explanatory text and a 'Browse All Products' link, no product data. /category/bogus-category renders 'Category Not Found' with no product cards.

Created 'QA Aeropress Go' (Home Goods) with all fields and edited seeded 'Philips Hue Starter Kit' (Home Goods) changing name->'Philips Hue Starter Kit QA', price 199->219, rating 4.4->4.1, image URL, short description, full review, tags, added a specification and toggled Featured on. Toast 'Product updated successfully'; /products card and /product/philips-hue-starter-kit-qa detail page immediately showed every changed value including the new image src and new 'QA Spec / QA Value 42' row.

Edited Philips Hue tags from 'lighting, smart-home, ambiance, automation' to 'lighting, smart-home, qa-ambience, qatagbeta' (added qatagbeta, renamed ambiance->qa-ambience, removed automation). Detail page shows exactly the 4 new tag chips; /products search 'qatagbeta' -> 1 product (that product), search 'ambiance' -> 0 products found.

issue: 'View all' featured link does not filter to featured products
actual: Toggling featured works on the homepage collection (un-featuring Dyson V15 Detect and featuring Philips Hue Starter Kit QA changed Editor's Top Picks from Sony/Peloton/Dyson to Sony/Peloton/Philips QA). But the 'View all' link from that section goes to /products?featured=true, which ignores the featured flag: it renders the heading 'All Products' with '9 products found', listing all products including the 6 non-featured ones. There is no way to browse only the featured set, and the homepage section itself is capped at 3 items.

issue: No persistence — all admin additions and edits are lost on reload
actual: Created 'QA Aeropress Go' and edited 'Philips Hue Starter Kit' -> 'Philips Hue Starter Kit QA' ($219, 4.1, new tags/specs/featured). After reloading /products the list is back to the 9 seeded products: the created product is gone and the edited one reverts to 'Philips Hue Starter Kit', $199, rating 4.4 with the original description. localStorage is empty and no data is persisted server-side; state also resets on any full page load (e.g. submitting the header search form).

evidence: Admin form Category is a single-value select restricted to Tech Gadgets / Home Goods / Fitness (no 'none' or multi-select). Every card on /products, category pages and homepage carries exactly one category badge; category counts 3+3+3 equal the 9-product total, and the created product added exactly 1 to Home Goods.

Visited all 9 seeded detail pages plus the created 'QA Aeropress Go'. Each shows name (h1), category badge, numeric rating + stars, brief description, price, tag chips, 'Key Specifications' list (5 rows for seeded items), product image and an external 'Buy Now' action, plus a 'My Review' section. E.g. Dyson V15 Detect: Home / 4.7 / $749 / 4 tags / 5 specs / https://example.com/dyson-v15.

All 9 seeded products use a topical category and 4 relevant tags, identical between browsing cards and detail pages: Sony=Tech/headphones,wireless,noise-cancelling,premium; Samsung=Tech/smartphone,android,camera,flagship; MacBook=Tech/laptop,apple,professional,portable; Bowflex=Fitness/weights,dumbbells,strength,home-gym; Theragun=Fitness/recovery,massage,muscle,therapy; Peloton=Fitness/cardio,cycling,smart-equipment,subscription; Breville=Home/coffee,espresso,kitchen,appliance; Philips Hue=Home/lighting,smart-home,ambiance,automation; Dyson=Home/vacuum,cordless,smart-home,cleaning.

Name, category, price, rating and brief description are byte-identical across homepage sections, /category/{tech,home,fitness}, /products and the detail page for all 9 products (e.g. Peloton Bike+ / Fitness / $2,495 / 4.6 / 'Premium connected fitness bike with rotating HD touchscreen and world-class instructors.'). Detail pages additionally render the full review in a 'My Review' section (408-462 chars, ending in complete sentences, no ellipsis/clamp) and the complete 5-row specification table.
